bugs.error_message: zsh: bus error when running run_analysis.py with MPS models
bugs.root_cause: C++ static destruction order fiasco in PyTorch MPS backend. MPS allocator's std::shared_timed_mutex is destroyed during C++ static teardown before Python's final GC runs tensor destructors. Tensor destructors try to use the already-destroyed MPS allocator, causing SIGBUS. Previous fix (disabling MPS) caused 3-5x slowdown. Inline cleanup after main() was too late.
bugs.fix: Two-layer fix: (1) cleanup() methods on every model class that cascade model.to(cpu) + gc.collect() + torch.mps.empty_cache(), (2) atexit handler that calls cleanup() on tracked models, then sweeps gc.get_objects() for any remaining MPS tensors and moves them to CPU, then gc.collect() + torch.mps.empty_cache(). Zero MPS tensors remain before Python final GC, so MPS allocator mutex destruction is harmless. No os._exit needed.
